info.name: Invex API
info.description: Every Invex endpoint in run order. Set adminUsername and adminPassword in the environment (never commit them), run the whole collection on a test copy of the database, and every request checks its status. Ids created along the way are saved as environment variables and deleted again in Clean-up.
